messages:
alice: Anyone hit a weird regression after the newest js-sdk publish? Next edge sample throws `ReferenceError: exports is not defined` and bundle size ballooned.

benj: Yup. Vendor chunk in sample-app jumped from ~400KB -> ~1.8MB. Build shows top-level code referencing \"exports\" in an ESM bundle.

maya: That smells like a CJS interop shim survived tree-shaking. Are we doing `export *` or namespace re-exports anywhere? Check package.json `sideEffects` and `exports` mapping.

alice: package.json currently: \"sideEffects\": false, \"exports\": { \".\": { \"import\": \"./dist/index.mjs\", \"require\": \"./dist/index.cjs\" } }. We build with esbuild in sample-app. Some builds resolve to the cjs path, causing the interop wrapper to leak.

sam: Repro: top-level `export * from './runtime'` while `runtime` historically uses `module.exports = {}`. That mix forces an interop wrapper referencing `exports`. Rollup/esbuild then can't fully tree-shake it. Stack: `ReferenceError: exports is not defined at eval (runtime-shim:1:12)`.

benj: TS patterns: `export * as runtime from './runtime'` can trigger a namespace object at runtime. Using `export { foo } from './runtime'` avoids it. Also `export type` is safe.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy failed: /api/generate returned 500 x85 between 2026-03-20T14:22:00Z and 2026-03-20T14:30:00Z.

maya: Short-term mitigations: 1) Replace namespace re-exports with explicit named re-exports; 2) Ensure bundler resolution prefers the `import` condition (set `conditions: [\"import\"]` or node-resolve plugin to prefer `module`); 3) Ship a tiny ESM wrapper that imports only the values we export rather than `export *`.

alice: Patch plan: - add `./dist/index.mjs` that imports named exports from runtime and re-exports them (no `export *`) - update package.json to make `import` route the default for the package root - set `tsconfig` flags where possible (preserveValueImports) - add a sample-app CI check asserting bundle < 600KB and no top-level `exports` string.

benj: For bundlers: Rollup -> `commonjs({ transformMixedEsModules: true })`. Esbuild-based toolchains -> ensure `conditions` include `import`. Also add a small postbuild scan to fail if `\"exports\"` appears at top-level.

sam: I'll smoke test Next edge and our internal infra service. If green, we should add a regression test to detect namespace-preserve regressions (bundle size + presence of `exports is not defined`).

maya: Types cleanups: change re-exports to `export type { T } from './types'` or `export { fn } from './runtime'` for values. Avoid `export * as` for value namespaces.

alice: Opening a PR with the ESM wrapper and exports map change now. @maya @benj please review. I'll attach before/after bundle artifacts. :thumbsup:

benj: I'll add a lightweight fixture test in devex/fixtures that imports the package through a pure ESM build and asserts no top-level `exports` and chunk sizes within thresholds.

alice: Thanks — landing canary soon and will report results.
